capability.summary: Fix the sample-browser autofocus race exposed by PR #42 Chrome CI: a 50 ms callback could steal focus from Close before Space activated it. Focus the mounted search field synchronously and deterministically exercise focus ownership across the former delay.

controls.description: Opening focuses search immediately; later user focus changes remain authoritative.
controls.test: Controlled-clock Chrome regression moves focus to Close before advancing through the former autofocus delay, then verifies Space closes the browser without starting transport.

fixtures: PR #42 e2e-gate run 34755019044: modal Space failure
Controlled-clock regression fails before fix and passes 20 consecutive times afterward
Actual local app: search focused on opening; Close returns to stopped library song
